home.title: Order a custom part as easily as anything else online
home.subtitle: Tell us what it's for. We choose the material and method, make it with a vetted manufacturing partner, check its quality and deliver it.

file.title: I have a file
file.body: Upload an STL or 3MF and get a price in minutes.

object.title: I have an object or a broken part
object.body: Send photos and a few measurements. We'll recreate it.

idea.title: I have an idea
idea.body: Describe what you need. We'll design and make it.

steps.s3: Get a firm price and date
steps.s4: We make, check and ship it

trust.qc: Every part is quality-checked before it ships

upload.title: Upload your 3D file
upload.hint: STL or 3MF, up to {max}. Your file stays private.
upload.noStep: STEP files aren't supported yet. Export STL or 3MF from your CAD tool, or send photos instead.

analysis.title: Checking your file
analysis.slow: This file is large, so analysis takes a little longer. You can keep going — we'll update this automatically.

failed.title: We couldn't read this file
failed.corrupt_file: The file looks damaged or isn't a 3D model. Try exporting it again.
failed.unsupported_format: This format isn't supported. Use STL or 3MF.
failed.too_large: The file is too large to analyze.
failed.too_complex: The model has too many triangles. Simplify it and try again.
failed.timeout: Analysis took too long. Try a simpler version of the file.
failed.degenerate_geometry: The model has no measurable volume.
failed.other: Something about this file needs a person to look at it.

warnings.not_watertight: The model has gaps in its surface. We'll check it before printing.
warnings.multiple_shells: The file contains several separate parts.
warnings.inconsistent_normals: Some surfaces face the wrong way; we'll fix that.

usage.title: How will you use it?
usage.intro: Plain answers are enough — we translate them into the right material and settings.

size.title: Confirm the size
size.intro: 3D files don't store units. Check that this is the real size of your part.
size.unitsHint: Small numbers often mean the file is in inches.

review.title: Your part
review.noPreview: A 3D preview isn't available for this file, but the measurements above are exact.

price.title: Your price
price.urgency: How soon do you need it?
price.estimate: Estimate — confirmed when you sign in
price.review: We'll check this one by hand
price.reviewBody: Something about this part needs a person to look at it. Send it and we'll reply with a quote within one business day.
price.signInToContinue: Sign in to continue — your progress is saved.

describe.photosHint: Add 2–5 photos from different angles. Put a coin or ruler next to it for scale.
describe.description: What is it and what should we make?
describe.descriptionHintObject: For example: “The clip that holds the dishwasher rack broke in half.”
describe.descriptionHintIdea: For example: “A wall mount for my router, screwed into drywall, cables hidden.”
describe.reference: Brand and model, if you know them

dimensions.title: Key measurements
dimensions.intro: The measurements that must be right. Add as many as you know.
dimensions.name: What you measured

submit.title: Ready to send
submit.body: Our team will review your request and reply within one business day with a quote.

account.title: Account
account.language: Language for emails and the site
account.privacyBody: To export or delete your data, contact us and we'll handle it within 30 days.
